issuer: the driving licence testing centre (DLTC) of the holder's area, under the provincial transport department
note: The South African Government's service page on applying for a driving licence (read 2026-10-30) says Code B is for a motor vehicle with a gross vehicle mass not exceeding 3 500 kg and one must be 18 or older to apply, so a licence is kept from 18. It sends the applicant to the local licensing office for the cost, so the fee is null; the card's term isn't on the page and is null. The green ID book and smart ID card are Home Affairs' (a different engine).

sources.title: South African Government, Apply for a driving licence
sources.said: Code B: This is for a motor vehicle, including a minibus, bus and goods vehicle, with a gross vehicle mass not exceeding 3 500 kg. You must be 18 years or older to apply. ... Contact your local licensing office to find out the cost.
